item.text: The duplicate prompt issue from the previous review appears addressed by a duplicate-allowed append path used only for the feature-done prompt. I’m checking the added repeated-flow tests and whether any new edge case falls out of keeping duplicate prompts in the transcript.

There is one remaining UI-cache gap: the controller now emits duplicate prompt events, but the terminal’s local render cache still deduplicates transcript lines. I’m checking whether the repeated-flow test asserts the visible second question; it currently only checks selection/close behavior.

I’m verifying the rendering chain rather than relying on intuition: the right pane renders from `self.snapshot.session(...).lines`, so if the duplicate prompt event is not inserted into that cache, the new question is not appended at the end of the visible chat.

FINDINGS

- `src/terminal_app.rs:724-807` still de-duplicates duplicate agent lines in the terminal render cache. Although `src/workspace.rs:701-704` now emits the repeated `FEATURE_DONE_PROMPT`, the second prompt event re-arms yes/no handling but is not appended to `self.snapshot.session(...).lines`, which `right_content` renders at `src/terminal_app.rs:1003-1008`. On a repeated review completion, the chat may highlight and accept `yes`, but the new “Is this feature done? yes/no” question is not shown at the end of the patch-agent chat. The new repeated-review test at `tests/terminal_app.rs:1154-1162` does not assert the second prompt is visible.
